'''Prellon Garn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] who went undercover in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Galactic War]], and discovered the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] construction of the [[Gauntlet (Sith Empire)|Gauntlet]].<ref name="Tor" />
